About

I am a first year Ph.D. student at Northeastern University. I work with Prof. Lu Wang on Natural Language Processing.
Prior to that I spent 4 years at Shanghai Jiao Tong University studying Computer Science. I was a member of ADAPT lab directed by Prof. Kenny Zhu.
Currently I’m working on Natural Language Generation, Summarization, and Chinese Named Entity Linking.
